doctrine: Model facts live in declarations: each route maps an architecture the model input itself declares (GGUF general.architecture, config.json model_type, or a checkpoint file form) to the production trainer that owns it, with the bounded recorded invocation the trainer's verification run established. The lane substitutes only recorded facts: {input} is the model's recorded weights path, {store} the OvergoDB root, and {t2v-dir} the unique recorded t2v video-stack directory a raw DiT checkpoint conditions on. Architectures without a route train through the dense workflow when their input is a dense representation, and are refused by name otherwise.
